# PCA General Assembly Minutes & Constitutional Catalogues (1973–2025)

> Verbatim, OCR-corrected markdown of all 52 volumes of the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA)
> *Minutes of the General Assembly*, plus structured, cross-referenced catalogues of judicial cases
> (SJC/CJB), overtures, constitutional inquiries (CCB), Review of Presbytery Records (RPR)
> exceptions of substance, and the denomination's position papers / study committee reports. Built for grounded research on the *Book of Church Order* (BCO) and PCA
> history: every catalogue entry deep-links to the verbatim minutes page it summarizes.

## How an AI assistant should use this

To answer a question about the BCO or PCA history, do NOT answer from memory — retrieve and cite:
1. Open the catalogue that matches the question (these are small, structured indexes):
   - Judicial cases (SJC/CJB) → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CASES.html
   - Judicial cases by constitutional provision → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CASES-BY-PROVISION.html
   - RPR exceptions of substance, by BCO provision → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR-BY-PROVISION.html
     (or by presbytery → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR.html and the per-presbytery pages it links)
   - Constitutional inquiries answered by the CCB → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INQUIRIES.html
   - CCB advice on proposed overtures/amendments → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CCB-OVERTURE-ADVICE.html
   - Overtures (proposals) and BCO amendments → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/OVERTURES.html
   - Position papers / study committee reports (incl. pastoral letters, declarations) → https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/STUDIES.html
2. Follow the deep link to the verbatim minutes page and quote the exact text.
3. Cite as `M<GA-ordinal>GA p.<printed page>` (e.g. M50GA p.517) plus the catalogue row.
4. The BCO is renumbered over time — a section cited in an old case may have a different number
   today; flag that rather than assuming the modern numbering.

## URL conventions — important
- For a user-facing link, use the published GitHub Pages URL ending in `.html`, not a repository-source `.md` URL.
- Repository Markdown deliberately uses relative `.md` links because Jekyll translates them during the site build. When reading raw catalogue source, convert a linked repository path such as `cases/ga10_1982__case5.md` to `https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/cases/ga10_1982__case5.html` before presenting it to a user.
- For machine retrieval of source Markdown, use `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raymond-rishty/pca-ga/main/...` and keep the `.md` suffix.
- Example: public page `https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/cases/ga10_1982__case5.html`; raw source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raymond-rishty/pca-ga/main/cases/ga10_1982__case5.md`.

## Catalogues (structured indexes — start here)
- [Corpus index](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INDEX.html) — the map of all 52 volumes + every catalogue.
- [Judicial cases](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CASES.html) — SJC/CJB cases: parties, disposition, BCO cited.
- [Judicial cases by constitutional provision](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CASES-BY-PROVISION.html) — cases grouped under the BCO/WCF/RAO provisions they cite.
- [Constitutional inquiries](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/INQUIRIES.html) — CCB advice on what the Constitution means.
- [CCB advice on overtures/amendments](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/CCB-OVERTURE-ADVICE.html)
- [Review of Presbytery Records — by provision](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR-BY-PROVISION.html) — which
  presbyteries were cited under each provision and whether it was resolved. [Hub](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/RPR.html)
- [Overtures](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/OVERTURES.html) — every overture + final outcome (incl. ratification).
- [Position papers & study committee reports](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/index/STUDIES.html) — study-committee / ad-interim reports, pastoral letters, declarations, statements, and adopted resolutions, grouped by topic; each links to the full verbatim report in the minutes.

## Verbatim minutes
- Source files: `markdown/ga<NN>_<YYYY>.md`, with deep-link anchors `#ga<ordinal>-p<printed-page>`.
- Published pages use the corresponding `.html` URL, e.g. https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/markdown/ga50_2023.html#ga50-p517.
- Cleanest for machine fetching is the raw markdown, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/raymond-rishty/pca-ga/main/markdown/ga50_2023.md

## One-file pack
- [llms-full.txt](https://raymond-rishty.github.io/pca-ga/llms-full.txt) — the corpus index + the compact catalogues (cases, inquiries,
  CCB advice, RPR hub) concatenated into ONE file you can fetch or upload in a single step. Links in
  this pack are canonical absolute public `.html` URLs. The two large indexes — OVERTURES and
  RPR-BY-PROVISION — are linked above; fetch them when needed.
